subject: Render DELTA5 plan: non-nil inert pass + depth/stencil contract
body:
Plan before editing (render scope explicitly includes nord2_render_pass.inc in TASK.md):
1. nord2_render_pass will never return nil for a non-committed descriptor: every refusal calls a bounded first-16 TEGU_PASS_REFUSED line=N reason=... , marks the command invalid (commit status Error), and returns a TeguRenderEncoder with inert=1/skipPass=1/ended=1 so all selectors are no-ops and endEncoding is safe.
2. Unsupported pass shapes (sampleCount>1, color resolveTexture, >2/mismatched color attachments, invalid targets) become inert/error. Attachment levels/slices/resolve levels remain exact.
3. Depth/stencil attachments are accepted for the exact subset where they cannot be observed: texture/id/size/format checks pass and storeAction is DontCare. The encoder records attachment presence/format. Pipeline depth/stencil pixel formats are accepted only in the JM path so RenderBox does not get a nil PSO; no depth hardware is claimed. setDepthStencilState records the immutable state. Draws whose state is disabled/always-no-write and stencil both-disabled proceed; any depth test/write or stencil test is refused per draw with a trace and no changed-result job. Non-JM behavior stays byte-compatible and keeps its explicit refusals.
4. Host test extends the real-frontend fake-JM harness: ASan/UBSan, sample4/resolve/mismatch/stencil/depth non-nil cases, the 14 RenderBox selectors on an inert encoder, commit Error, bounded TEGU_PASS_REFUSED count, plus an accepted memoryless depth/stencil no-test draw and an explicit stencil-test refusal. No native build or device action.
